name: Confession Box
source:
A thief on the run finds refuge in a church confession box. Help sinners while avoiding suspicion!

[From [url=https://cmangos.itch.io/confession-box]itch.io[/url]]

一名亡命潜逃的小偷躲进教堂的告解室避难。在不引起怀疑的前提下，为前来告解的罪人们排忧解难吧！
